title: ci(spec-shape-gate): drop the closed objectui#12325 retirement entry and point the header at the deleted objectui copy’s last commit
body:
Part of #23782

Clause-②: no

## What

- **`scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`**: deletes the one entry, whose `downstream_card` is objectstack-ai/objectui#12325. That card closed `completed` on 2026-10-14, and the file's own `$comment` says an entry is deleted when its card closes. The entry's `packages/**` patterns (`TS2367` / `TS2678` with message `'"api"'`) would have read a later, unrelated break of the same shape as `known` instead of red. The registry is now `"retirements": []`. The `$comment` and the grammar are unchanged.
- **`scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs`, header (comments only)**: says that objectui deleted its copy in objectstack-ai/objectui PR #12596 (card objectstack-ai/objectui#12352), so this gate is the only one. The "port of objectui's `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs`" sentence now points at objectui commit `7d0c174ba8383d08b8dd1d4f7d7845009f1bf2fd` for the measurements the header does not restate. The registry example's `downstream_card` is now `objectstack-ai/objectui#N`.
- **Self-test fixture**: `FIXTURE_ENTRY.downstream_card` and the two checks that read it now use `objectstack-ai/objectui#999999` instead of the closed card's number. The malformed-card sample changes the same way. These are fixture literals; no reader, matcher or assertion changes.

No change to the gate's logic, `MARKER_FILE`, or the "marker name is objectui's, on purpose" paragraph.

## Measurements

- **The reader accepts an empty list.** `parseRegistry` requires `Array.isArray(doc.retirements)` and then checks each entry in a loop. Run on the edited live file, it returns 0 entries and does not throw. `pnpm check:spec-shape-gate` (the `--self-test`): `60/60 passed across 7 batteries`, exit 0.
- **The pointer commit.** In a blobless clone of objectstack-ai/objectui, `git log -- scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` shows that the newest commit touching the file is merge `c6a42be392cf9ae820424a694c59fb2a7287d2ae` (PR #12596, which deletes it). Its first parent is `7d0c174ba8383d08b8dd1d4f7d7845009f1bf2fd`. `git cat-file -e` confirms that `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` and `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml` both exist at that commit, and that `c6a42be392` is on objectui `main`.
- `git grep -n 'objectui#12325' -- scripts/ci`: 0 hits (exit 1).

## Choice: a pointer, not moving the measurements here

Weighed on the four axes:
- **Real need:** nobody here reads or maintains the injection measurements. The mechanism is unchanged, and the measurements stay reachable at a fixed commit.
- **Long-term soundness:** a pinned 40-hex commit cannot drift. A copied header would become a second text that ages.
- **Hard for an AI to get wrong:** the pointer names the exact `git show` path.
- **No scope spread at the startup stage:** copying the measurements adds text nobody here maintains.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this branch's diff derived 29 commands. All 29 exited 0 (each exit code captured before any pipe). Reconciliation with `--ran`: `29 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 29 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.

## Changeset

None. The diff touches only `scripts/ci/**` at the repository root (root `package.json` is `private: true`), and no package's `package.json` names either file. Nothing published changes.

## Acceptance notes

The workflow header paragraph (item 1 of the card) is in the companion Tier H PR, `claude/issue-23782-spec-shape-workflow-header`, which the maintainer lands.
